app.name: Tempo
app.primary_job: Read agent work, edit a project, and manage chats

screen.name: Workspace
screen.purpose: Read a conversation and inspect project changes beside it

image_legend: Image 3: full-width application header and chat tabs

usability_secondary_disclosure.instructions: In a conversation workspace, how are less frequent configuration, copying and help actions presented relative to reading, sending a message and switching chats?
criteria: Less frequent actions occupy a separate persistent toolbar or several prominent controls alongside the everyday conversation actions.
Most less frequent actions are in menus, but some unrelated controls still compete with the main conversation controls.
Everyday conversation controls remain visible, while less frequent actions are available through labeled menus, tooltips or contextual controls.
